pages: Nell, eleven, brown hair in two braids, in a faded red t-shirt and blue denim overalls, stands in the kitchen doorway with heavy eyes, one hand on the frame, looking at the round wall clock. Middle distance: dinner plates stacked on the table, a chair pushed back. Background: a low window full of deep orange afternoon light.

Nell, eleven, brown hair in two braids, in a faded red t-shirt and blue denim overalls, steps out of the shed in yellow gumboots, one hand on the latch, looking up the lane. Middle distance: one galvanised milk can on its stand, a hose coiled on the wall. Background: the concrete yard and a dark paddock, cold blue light.

Nell, eleven, brown hair in two braids, in a faded red t-shirt and blue denim overalls, crouches with one hand flat on the back of one black-and-white dog that backs away from the hose. Middle distance: a galvanised milk can under the hose, a hose reeled on the wall. Background: the shed wall and the lane beyond. Cold light.

Nell, eleven, brown hair in two braids, in a faded red t-shirt and blue denim overalls, sits on the front step with one hand on a canvas school bag, one sock on. Middle distance: yellow gumboots in the grass, milk cans going down the lane. Background: the road and the hedge, low early sun.

Nell, eleven, brown hair in two braids, in a faded red t-shirt and blue denim overalls, lies awake under a single blanket in the dark, one hand reaching for the small alarm clock. Middle distance: school clothes folded on a chair, a glass of water. Background: a blind down over the window, a thin grey stripe of light. Blue dark.

Nell, eleven, brown hair in two braids, in a faded red t-shirt and blue denim overalls, presses one finger on a white card on her knee, one blue pencil lying beside it. Middle distance: a stack of white cards squared on the desk, a steel ruler. Background: the sick room window, a pale wall, flat daylight.

Nell, eleven, brown hair in two braids, in a faded red t-shirt and blue denim overalls, writes on a white card held flat on her knee with one blue pencil, brow down. Middle distance: more white cards squared on the desk, a steel ruler. Background: the sick room window and pale wall, flat morning light.

Nell, eleven, brown hair in two braids, in a faded red t-shirt and blue denim overalls, holds a white card up in one hand and reads a blue pencil arrow drawn beside one line. Middle distance: the desk, a steel ruler, the blue pencil. Background: the sick room window and pale wall, flat daylight.

Nell, eleven, brown hair in two braids, in a faded red t-shirt and blue denim overalls, draws small sums on the inside of her forearm with the point of one blue pencil. Middle distance: a white card face down on the desk, her sleeve pushed back. Background: the window and the grey morning outside, flat light.

Nell, eleven, brown hair in two braids, in a faded red t-shirt and blue denim overalls, sits on the edge of her bed writing on one white card on the bedside table with one blue pencil. Middle distance: a lamp, her school bag on the floor. Background: a bedroom window with the blind down, lamplight on the wall.

Nell, eleven, brown hair in two braids, in a faded red t-shirt and blue denim overalls, stands by the door with one white card in her hand and one blue pencil, ready for the shed. Middle distance: yellow gumboots, a milk can in the wash. Background: the milking shed and a pale afternoon sky, long light.

Nell, eleven, brown hair in two braids, in a faded red t-shirt and blue denim overalls, sits at the kitchen table writing in the margin of one white card with one blue pencil. Middle distance: a mug of tea, the checked cloth. Background: a low window with the morning in it, a jacket over a chair. Soft daylight.
